informal_statement:
Let

$$
G=\{a+b\sqrt{2}\in\mathbb{R}\mid a,b\in\mathbb{Q}\}.
$$

(a) Prove that $G$ is a group under addition.

(b) Prove that $G\setminus\{0\}$ is a group under multiplication.
lean_statement: (∃ A : AddSubgroup ℝ, (A : Set ℝ) = AI4Algebra.Benchmarks.Selected.quadraticSet) ∧ (∃ M : Subgroup ℝˣ, (M : Set ℝˣ) = {x : ℝˣ | (x : ℝ) ∈ AI4Algebra.Benchmarks.Selected.quadraticSet})
